gumroad_listing.title: SAM.gov Small Biz Contractor Leads — DMV IT Corridor — 4,731 Records (CSV)
gumroad_listing.description:
4,731 SAM.gov-registered small business government IT contractors in Virginia, DC, and Maryland with **active** registrations, sourced from USASpending.gov (FFATA-mandated public data).

**What's included:**
- Legal business name (all verified entities — no sole proprietors)
- UEI SAM identifier
- CAGE code (where available)
- NAICS codes (19 IT/tech codes: 541511, 541512, 541513, 541519, 541611, 518210...)
- Small business certifications (8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, EDWOSB, SDVOSB, Veteran-Owned, SBA)
- Physical address (commercial addresses only)
- State (VA / MD / DC)
- Active registration status
- SAM.gov entity source URL for every row

**Certification counts:**
- Small Business: 5,377 (pre-filter) → commercial subset
- 8(a): 2,956 · Veteran-Owned: 1,795 · WOSB: 1,450 · SDVOSB: 1,278 · HUBZone: 608

**Top states:** VA 4,313 · MD 2,615 · DC 613

**Who buys this:** Subcontractors who need teaming partners for 8(a)/HUBZone/WOSB set-aside bids, IT staffing firms targeting federal prime contractors, SaaS vendors selling into the federal IT market — anyone who needs a clean filtered list without paying $200+/month for GovWin or SamSearch.

**Data source:** USASpending.gov FFATA public transparency API. Addresses are commercial business registrations from federal procurement records for B2B teaming research. Not for consumer outreach.

pre_ship_requirements: Gumroad listing must include disclosure: addresses are FFATA-mandated public SAM.gov registrations intended for B2B teaming research only
